non_blind_reason: the seed-42 anchor 0.6080587938801277, the frozen five-seed mean 0.5861142332208197 and the Week 8 C4 delta readings were all known before this file was written
question: with the pool, folds, scorer and the 13-column Physical(lever4) block frozen, does swapping the *target* (fit epsilon - epsilon_Onsager instead of epsilon, then add the analytic term back) beat the frozen head on the five-seed mean R2?

frozen_protocol.head_process: ProcessPoolExecutor over (repeat, fold) tasks, one fold per task
frozen_protocol.seed_handling: exactly the shot-16 convention: only the *fold draw* changes with the seed, the model keeps the frozen random_state = SEED = 42 on every seed. The reference arm must therefore reproduce all five frozen full_table_lever4/Physical readings bit for bit, not just seed 42.

onsager_definition.high_frequency_epsilon: n2 = (1 + 2 q) / (1 - q) with q = N_A alpha / (3 V_m) (Lorentz-Lorenz)
onsager_definition.reaction_field: A = N_A mu^2 / (9 eps_0 k_B T V_m)
onsager_definition.dipole_density_term: mu_sq_over_Vm = dipole_D^2 / V_m with dipole_D in debye and V_m in m^3 mol^-1, so mu_sq_over_Vm carries the unit D^2 mol m^-3
onsager_definition.unit_conversion: (mu_sq_over_Vm) * (debye_to_coulomb_metre^2) * N_A / (9 eps_0 k_B T) is dimensionless because D^2 -> C^2 m^2 and mol^-1 * N_A -> 1
onsager_definition.molar_volume_from_the_matrix: V_m = molecular_volume_A3 * 1e-30 * N_A: the PHYSICAL_COLUMNS entry molecular_volume_A3 is a per-molecule volume in Angstrom^3, not a molar volume. This was the first unit trap and it is why the raw column cannot be used as V_m directly.
onsager_definition.polarizability_density: q = polarizability_A3 / (3 * molecular_volume_A3) = alpha_over_Vm / 3; the Avogadro factor cancels because both entries are per-molecule volumes
onsager_definition.validation: the vectorised form must match electrolyte_ml.xtb_features.onsager_dielectric_estimate row by row; the max absolute gap is recorded in the summary and must be <= 1e-09
onsager_definition.sanity_check_targets: water ~44 (obs 87), methanol ~17 (obs 39), dimethyl sulfoxide ~41 (obs 51), acetonitrile ~54 (obs 38); the estimate has to be the same order of magnitude as the observation and must never reach the eps > 60 zone, which is the known association failure

arm_definitions.reference_direct: the frozen head XGBRegressor(**XGB_PARAMS, random_state=SEED=42) fits epsilon itself; this is the anchor and must reproduce all five frozen full_table_lever4/Physical readings bit for bit
arm_definitions.onsager_analytic_only: no learning: the closed-form Onsager estimate from the frozen lever4 columns (dipole_D, molecular_volume_A3, polarizability_A3, T_K) is the whole prediction
arm_definitions.onsager_delta_xgb: the same frozen head fits the residual epsilon - epsilon_Onsager and the analytic term is added back on the held-out fold
arm_definitions.onsager_delta_recomputed: the same delta scheme with the analytic term recomputed from the frozen v0.4 conformer table at probes/artifacts/dielectric_xtb_full_table_migration_conformers.csv using the single-conformer dipole density mu_sq_over_Vm_frozen, i.e. a different dipole source than the conformer-averaged one the lever4 column carries; compounds without a table row fall back to the lever4 term

arm_notes.conformer_mean_route_is_not_a_separate_a: the table's mu_sq_over_Vm_conformer_mean equals the lever4 column by construction (dipole_map_from_conformer_rows feeds dipole_D and mu_sq_over_Vm = dipole_D^2 / V_m), so a conformer-mean arm would duplicate onsager_delta_xgb. The equality is verified at run time and recorded as a wiring check instead.
arm_notes.no_hyperparameter_search: the head stays the frozen XGB_PARAMS and no grid is run, because Week 17 shot 17 showed inner-fold family selection does not transfer at 97 compounds / 276 samples

decision_rule.endpoint: cross-seed mean of the 10-repeat-mean R2 over the pre-registered seed set 42,1234,2026,31337,7
decision_rule.confirmed: cross-seed mean of the arm >= cross-seed mean of reference_direct + 0.02
decision_rule.partial: cross-seed mean of the arm >= cross-seed mean of reference_direct + 0.005 but below the confirmed bar
decision_rule.refuted: no judged arm reaches +0.005 over reference_direct
decision_rule.placebo: verdict is placebo when --placebo is used; the target is permuted on the scored compounds only and every delta arm must collapse towards the direct arm

anchors.fold_signature: must equal dielectric_pool_expansion_benchmark.fold_signature of the frozen scoreboard splits at the anchor seed 42 (only seed 42 shares the frozen fold draw; every other seed re-draws the folds by design, and the resulting signature is recorded as information)
anchors.on_mismatch: at seed 42, refuse to report anything else and exit non-zero

known_prior: Week 8 C4 ran an Onsager delta layer under an MAE / RepeatedKFold protocol on a different pool; the confirmatory arm D1_delta_core_morgan scored 8.54 MAE against the plain direct regressor R0 at 6.36, and Onsager was not promoted to a standalone predictor. That reading is a prior, not a result of this probe.
promotion_rule: no reading from this probe is promoted; the frozen headline stays 0.4766400383507876 and the frozen baseline stays 0.4091179943351143 regardless of the outcome
